name: NDesigner
description: A free global community for designers that I founded: chat across countries, message each other and show your work in a portfolio :)
fullDescription: ND (NDesigner) is a free online community for designers from all over the world, and I am its founder. I designed it and built it myself, logo included: a global chat with groups and a room for every country, direct messages, and one shared portfolio format that helps clients find the right designer faster. It has a light and a dark theme and a language switcher, so designers from any country feel at home. And 5 more projects for the designer community are on the way :)
